facts.fact: PTI reports the government cloud backup centre, housed at INFOSI in Luanda with 48 racks and about 8.5 PB, was reinaugurated on 2026-08-25 and replicates in real time the data of the government data centre at Camama; main site in Camama, backup in Luanda (INFOSI premises).
